text:
maria.s: incident-bot autopage fired for METRICS_SCRAPE_FAILURES and LOG_INGEST_LAG across prod-us-west clusters — PD: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC12345 created, urgency: high, policy: metrics-oncall-escalation. Initial symptom: Prometheus 'scrape_duration_seconds' spikes and log-ingest queue depth > 250k for 5+ mins.
pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to on-call: chris-l. Escalation timer started.
chris-l: oncall here, looking. first check: grafana and prometheus targets
jamal: grabbing prometheus targets now — running: `curl -s 'http://prom-prod-us-west:9090/api/v1/targets' | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | {job: .labels.job, state: .health, lastError: .lastError}'`
jamal: results: most exporter jobs green but `node-exporter-prod` and `app-metrics-exporter` show intermittent DOWN with lastError: "context deadline exceeded" and connection refused for ~10s windows
chris-l: grafana dashboard shows scrape_duration p95 jumped from 120ms -> 2.4s around 22:07 UTC, correlated with spike in scrape failures and fanout to log ingest
leo-oncall: log-ingest queue depth map -> kafka partition lag up 4x on ingest-topic, consumer group metrics show consumer 'log-ingestor' falling behind
maria.s: potential root cause: exporter outage causing scrape retries -> fanout -> log pipeline backpressure. is this affecting customer-facing product metrics?
jamal: quick grep of logs from exporter pods: `kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/app-metrics-exporter --since=15m | tail -n 100` shows many TLS handshake timeouts and occasional OOMKilled on one replica
chris-l: ok mitigation plan: 1) scale app-metrics-exporter to 4 -> reduce per-pod load 2) restart prom-scrape pods to clear stuck connections 3) temporarily increase scrape timeout backoff and suppress autopage duplicates
chris-l: running `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/app-metrics-exporter --replicas=4`
incident-bot: Action logged: scaled app-metrics-exporter -> 4 replicas (chris-l)
jamal: triggering rollout restart of prom-scrape: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-server`
chris-l: restarted prom-scrape, seeing immediate drop in per-scrape latency on /metrics endpoints in prometheus targets view
leo-oncall: kafka consumer lag decreasing by ~30% in last 90s, queue depth trending down from 270k -> 140k
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC12345 acknowledged by chris-l at 22:12 UTC
maria.s: quick customer impact note: internal dashboards experienced partial missing series for ~8-12 minutes, external customer metrics APIs shows no errors reported, no customer-facing incidents so far.
chris-l: thumbs on that. will leave autosuppress rule in place for duplicate METRICS_SCRAPE_FAILURES alerts for 10m while we stabilize
jamal: found exporter pod with OOMKilled: image: app-metrics-exporter:v1.14.7, memory usage spike to 1.8Gi on node gpu-12. probably memory leak in v1.14.7 under high scrape fanout
leo-oncall: created follow-up ticket: RINF-4823 investigating exporter mem leak and TLS handshake failures. assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2.
maria.s: adding action item: add liveness/readiness tuning and increase HPA for exporter or split heavy endpoints into separate job.
chris-l: recommended long-term fix: add per-target scrape staleness handling and implement prefix caching, also consider rate-limit exporter endpoints.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring. Next escalation paused.
leo-oncall: handing off to next oncall jamal for follow-up; summary: exporter instability caused scrape retries -> log ingest backlog -> PD autopage. Mitigation done: scaled exporter, restarted prom, backlog draining. Please own RINF-4823 and coordinate with eng-runtime.
jamal: taking handoff, I'll keep an eye through 23:30 UTC and update RINF-4823 with heap/profile snapshots.
maria.s: thanks all — will draft incident summary and customer impact note in postmortem doc. tagging: @eng-runtime for heads-up. :white_check_mark:
chris-l: closing this thread, will mark PD alert resolved once backlog is under 20k and exporter replica stabilizes.
incident-bot: PD alert INC12345 resolved by chris-l at 22:28 UTC. Resolution note: exporters scaled and restarted; backlog drained; follow-up RINF-4823 opened.
leo-oncall: postmortem next steps: 1) correlate exporter release v1.14.7 rollout times 2) add circuit-breaker on scrape fanout 3) improve alert granularity so we don't autopage for short-lived spike.
jamal: uploading heap dump & prometheus scrape logs to RINF-4823: https://rinfra.example/RINF-4823/artifacts
maria.s: closing notes: no customer-facing outage, internal dashboards impacted ~10m, action items assigned.
chris-l: ack, thanks team. :thumbsup:
